job.title: Lawyer | Financial Services
job.description:
The Opportunity
Are you a commercially minded lawyer looking to build your career in financial services? This is an outstanding opportunity to join a fast growing, well established lending group where legal is viewed as a genuine business partner, not just a support function.
Operating across lending, asset finance, and consumer credit, this organisation combines entrepreneurial growth with the sophistication and governance of a highly regulated financial institution. You'll work closely with senior decision makers, gain exposure to complex transactions and structuring matters, and play a key role in helping the business manage risk while driving growth.
For lawyers seeking a move in house, this role offers the chance to step beyond pure legal advice and become deeply involved in commercial outcomes.

The Role
Reporting into a highly experienced legal team, you'll enjoy a broad and varied practice spanning transactional, commercial, property, and financial services law.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a broad range of commercial agreements, lending documents and finance transactions.
  • Managing lending and asset finance matters from inception through to completion.
  • Advising on trust structures, security arrangements and transaction structuring across the lending portfolio.
  • Supporting property backed finance transactions, including due diligence, securities, settlements and related documentation.
  • Working closely with brokers, external legal advisers and business stakeholders to facilitate seamless transaction execution.
  • Providing practical, commercially focused advice on legal and regulatory issues affecting lending and credit products.
  • Maintaining strong transaction management and record keeping practices across a high volume workflow.
  • Contributing to the ongoing development of legal precedents, documentation and internal processes to improve efficiency and consistency.
About You
We're interested in lawyers who enjoy working close to the commercial coalface and are excited by the opportunity to build a long term career within financial services.

You'll likely bring:
  • A Bachelor of Laws and approximately 3 to 5 years post admission experience gained in commercial, property, banking and finance, or corporate transactions.
  • Experience advising on property transactions, lending arrangements, trust structures or secured finance matters.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent organisational abilities and the confidence to manage multiple matters simultaneously.
  • A pragmatic, solutions focused mindset with a genuine interest in understanding how financial products and transactions work.
  • The ability to communicate complex legal concepts clearly to both legal and non legal stakeholders.
  • An interest in financial services regulation, with exposure to areas such as ASIC, the Corporations Act, NCCP, Privacy, AML/CTF and PPS legislation highly regarded.
Why Apply?
This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional legal practice and become an integral part of a growing financial services business. You'll gain exposure to a diverse range of transactions, work directly with commercial stakeholders, and develop expertise in a sector that continues to evolve and expand.
If you're looking for an in house role where your advice influences real business decisions and your career can grow alongside a successful organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, you're welcome to contact Jenny Quigley at SB Recruitment on 02 9002 5005, or apply via the link to submit your application today.

job.title: IT Business Analyst (Accounting Technology & Digital Systems) | Sydney CBD
job.description:
SB Recruitment is working in collaboration with Obsidian Advisory Pty Ltd to source two experienced IT Business Analysts to join their Sydney-based team.

About Obsidian Advisory

Obsidian Advisory is a dynamic, tech-driven Chartered Accounting firm based in Sydney, committed to delivering corporate-grade accounting, tax, virtual CFO, bookkeeping, payroll and financial modelling services to small and medium-sized businesses, franchises and family groups.

Founded by two young and energetic partners with Big 4 backgrounds, the firm leads with a digital-first philosophy and a "plain English" promise — making finance accessible and actionable for its clients.

As a Xero Gold Partner and Certified Advisor, Obsidian Advisory is at the forefront of cloud accounting technology and is investing in expanding its internal technology and systems capability to better support its growing client base.

The Opportunity

SB Recruitment, in collaboration with Obsidian Advisory, is seeking two skilled and motivated IT Business Analysts to join the business in Sydney.

These newly created roles will support Obsidian Advisory's digital transformation initiatives — from streamlining internal accounting systems and workflows to building better client-facing solutions for UHNW clients.

You will serve as a critical bridge between the firm's accounting professionals and the technology platforms that power its work. This is an excellent opportunity for results-driven professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are passionate about applying technology to drive business efficiency.

Salary: $90,000 + Superannuation per annum.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyse, document and re-engineer internal business processes across accounting, tax, bookkeeping, payroll and CFO service delivery workflows
  • Work with partners and service teams to gather and translate business requirements into functional technology specifications
  • Lead and manage the implementation and integration of accounting and business software systems, including Xero and associated cloud platforms
  • Conduct usability assessments, A/B testing and stakeholder interviews to identify pain points and system improvement opportunities
  • Design BPMN-level process maps (Level 1–3) to document end-to-end operational and information flows
  • Collaborate with external software vendors and developers to deliver technology solutions on time and within scope
  • Develop and maintain business intelligence reporting and KPI dashboards to support data-driven decision making for partners and client-facing teams
  • Apply machine learning or AI-assisted tools to automate and accelerate business process design and client data analysis where appropriate
  • Provide training and documentation to internal staff on new systems and workflows
  • Support planning for CapEx, HR requirements and project delivery timelines for technology initiatives
  • Report on project progress and technology requirements to the executive team and external stakeholders where required
What You'll Bring

Essential:
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of full-time experience as a Business Analyst or IT Business Systems Analyst
  • Minimum 3 years of full-time experience working with UHNW individuals
  • Demonstrated experience using Agile methodology to deliver IT projects
  • Strong proficiency in process mapping tools (Visio, BPMN) and project management platforms (MS Project, Trello, Jira or similar)
  • Experience gathering business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops and qualitative/quantitative research methods
  • Solid understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) and system integration projects
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and digital collaboration tools including Zoom, Slack and Google Workspace
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong documentation, report-writing and presentation skills
Highly Desirable:
  • Experience with cloud accounting platforms, particularly Xero
  • Familiarity with financial services, accounting or professional services environments
  • Experience working in multicultural and internationally distributed teams
  • Exposure to machine learning, AI-assisted tools or data-driven business process automation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver projects ahead of schedule and within budget
  • Experience mentoring team members or conducting training workshops
Why Join Obsidian Advisory?
  • Work directly alongside experienced Chartered Accountants and partners in a collaborative, non-hierarchical environment
  • Be at the centre of a firm-wide digital transformation with real ownership over outcomes
  • Competitive salary package, commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving, ambitious firm
How to Apply

Please send your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and suitability for the role to: admin@obsidianadvisory.com.au

Please include "IT Business Analyst Application" in the subject line.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.title: Compliance Officer
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a well established, privately owned financial services provider that has built a strong reputation for delivering responsible lending solutions and exceptional customer service across Australia.
Based on the Gold Coast, the business has experienced consistent growth and continues to invest in its people, systems and governance framework to support its long term success. Operating within a highly regulated environment, they are committed to maintaining the highest standards of compliance, ethical decision making and delivering fair customer outcomes.
Combining the agility of a growing organisation with the stability of an established financial services business, they offer a collaborative and supportive culture where employees have direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful business improvements.
This is an excellent opportunity to join an organisation where compliance is viewed as a valued business partner.

The Job
Reporting to the Risk & Compliance Manager, this role suits a compliance professional who is comfortable working independently, forming their own view on whether procedures and controls actually meet regulatory obligations, and raising concerns where they don't.
Working closely with lending, collections, hardship and customer service teams, you'll take ownership of monitoring and testing activities, using your judgement to identify gaps between what policy says and what's happening in practice, and driving improvements that lift the business's regulatory position.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Independently monitoring compliance with relevant legislation, regulatory obligations and internal policies, escalating concerns where obligations may not be met.
  • Designing and conducting compliance reviews, testing and file audits across operational teams, forming your own conclusions on adequacy of controls.
  • Critically assessing customer files and business processes against regulatory requirements, questioning whether existing procedures are fit for purpose.
  • Owning and maintaining compliance, breach and incident registers.
  • Leading elements of regulatory change initiatives and compliance projects.
  • Preparing compliance reports, dashboards and management reporting that clearly articulate risk and control gaps.
  • Supporting and at times leading investigations, remediation activities and corrective action plans.
You
To be successful in this role, you will bring:
  • 3 to 5 years experience within Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance or Audit, ideally within financial services, with a track record of working with a degree of autonomy.
  • Relevant qualifications in Compliance, Risk, Finance, Business, Law or a related discipline will be highly regarded.
  • Solid exposure to consumer or commercial lending environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of NCCP, responsible lending obligations and ASIC regulatory requirements, with the confidence to apply this knowledge independently.
  • A naturally inquisitive mindset, comfortable questioning whether current processes genuinely meet regulatory obligations rather than assuming they do.
  • Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Well developed written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders across the business.
  • A proactive attitude with a genuine desire to continue developing your compliance career and take on greater ownership.
How to Apply
If you're looking to take the next step in your compliance career and join a growing financial services organisation where you'll work with a good degree of autonomy, broaden your experience and make a genuine contribution, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply now by submitting your resume, or contact Jenny Quigley 02 9002 5005 for a confidential discussion.
